description: The default reporter's failure line (T1.7, report.displaySeparator and failureTitleBullet): a failing test inside a describe. Jest's default reporter (on stderr, beside --json) prints a bulleted title joined with ' › '; Vitest's (asked for beside the recorder's json reporter, on stdout) prints FAIL, the file and the names joined with ' > '. Only the lines naming the test are kept.
